title: Multiplying Integers
short: A negative times a negative is positive, and the pattern shows why.
trouble: Students carry the multiplication rule into addition, saying −3 + −4 = 7 because "two negatives make a positive."

blocks.html: Multiplying by a whole number is repeated adding: $3 \times (-4)$ means three groups of $-4$, so $(-4) + (-4) + (-4) = -12$. But what could $(-3) \times (-4)$ mean? Nobody can make "negative three groups." A pattern answers the question.

Multiply the absolute values. The product is positive when the signs are the same and negative when they are different. With more factors, an even number of negative signs gives a positive product; an odd number gives a negative one.

Look at the pattern: $3 \times (-4) = -12$, $2 \times (-4) = -8$, $1 \times (-4) = -4$, $0 \times (-4) = 0$. Each time the first factor goes down by 1, we take away one group of $-4$, and the product goes up by 4. Keep the pattern going: $(-1) \times (-4) = 4$ and $(-2) \times (-4) = 8$.
The distributive property says the same thing: $$0 = (-1) \times (4 + (-4)) = (-1)(4) + (-1)(-4) = -4 + (-1)(-4)$$ The only number that makes this true is $(-1)(-4) = 4$.

blocks.name: g7-signpattern
blocks.cap: Press "Next row" to keep the pattern going past 0. Each row adds 4, so the products turn positive.

blocks.title: Different signs
steps: The signs are different, so the product is negative.

blocks.title: Same signs
steps: Both factors are negative, so the product is positive.

blocks.title: Three factors
steps: Three negative signs: the first two make a positive, and the third makes it negative again.

blocks.html: Using the multiplying rule when adding: "two negatives make a positive," so $-3 + (-4) = 7$. Not so: adding two negatives is two moves to the left, $-3 + (-4) = -7$. The rule "same signs give a positive" is only for multiplying and dividing. Before you answer, name the operation.

A story where a negative times a negative happens: the temperature falls 2 degrees every hour, a rate of $-2$. Three hours ago is time $-3$. The change from now to then is $(-3) \times (-2) = 6$: it was 6 degrees warmer.
